# JalaDrishti AI

> Enterprise Earth Observation & AI decision-support platform for municipal flood resilience,
> satellite waterlogging detection, and precision agro-hydrology across Karnataka, India.

## What this project is

JalaDrishti AI is a full-stack multimodal platform that combines Sentinel-1 SAR imagery,
Sentinel-2 optical bands, SRTM DEM elevation data, and live Open-Meteo rainfall measurements
to produce real-time flood inundation maps and actionable engineering advisories for
municipalities and farmers in Karnataka.

## Core capabilities

- **Flood & Waterlogging Map** — AI-powered (Random Forest / XGBoost) per-pixel flood
  severity classification (Low / Moderate / Severe) for all 31 Karnataka districts using
  Sentinel SAR + optical + terrain features.

- **Weather & Radar Observatory** — Real-time 10-day weather forecasts, rainfall accumulation,
  flood risk ratings, and Doppler radar playback for all Karnataka districts via Open-Meteo API.

- **Crop Water & Irrigation Advisor** — FAO-56 Dual Crop Coefficient engine using
  Hargreaves-Samani ET₀ with 100+ Karnataka crops, 12 soil series, and daily soil moisture
  depletion to generate precision irrigation schedules.

- **Drainage Action Center** — Automated priority-ranked (P1 Critical / P2 High / P3 Routine)
  municipal drainage engineering advisories derived from ML flood severity and terrain slope.

- **Live IoT Sensor Telemetry** — Simulated water-level ultrasonic sensors and pump relay
  status (8-second polling via Arduino/sensor backend).

- **Emergency Operations Center (EOC)** — Real-time alert triage, critical zone summary,
  and structured incident response protocols.

- **Citizen SOS & Lifeline Hub** — Crowdsourced flood reports, nearest relief shelter
  locator, and emergency helpline directory.

## Technical stack

- Frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Leaflet + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion
- Backend: Node.js + Express + TypeScript (API gateway, PostgreSQL integration)
- ML Service: Python FastAPI + scikit-learn (Random Forest, XGBoost), geospatial ML
- Data sources: Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 MSI, SRTM DEM, CHIRPS, Open-Meteo (all free/open)

## Public pages

- / — Root; defaults to Flood Map tab
- /#weather — Weather & Radar Observatory
- /#crop-water — Crop Water & Irrigation Advisor
- /#drainage — Drainage Action Center

## Data & privacy

- No user accounts or personal data are collected.
- All geospatial data is sourced from open/public Earth Observation archives.
- API keys (Google Maps, etc.) are environment-specific and not exposed.

## Contact

This is a research/academic project developed for Karnataka municipal flood resilience.
